worldcombat.skill.mist.summary: Cloaks the body and nearby allies in a white mist; inside it no combatant's stat stages can be lowered. The mist follows the caster, and anyone who leaves its reach loses the cover.
worldcombat.skill.mist.use.0: Block blanket drops to defence, attack or speed
worldcombat.skill.mist.use.1: Cover an ally that is winding up or setting up
worldcombat.skill.mist.use.2: Raise the mist before the foe starts weakening you
worldcombat.skill.mist.description.0: The mist covers the caster and allies within %2$s blocks for %1$s: any stat-stage drop is swallowed by the mist on the next tick and restored on the spot.
worldcombat.skill.mist.description.1: the current cast range is %2$s blocks. It only stops drops, not damage or control.
worldcombat.skill.mist.description.2: Breathing the mist takes %1$s, the recovery is %2$s and the cooldown %3$s. See the veil note for the dense/thin trade-off.
worldcombat.skill.mist.veil.0: Dense: radius x1.25, duration x1.2, density x1.3, at +3 ticks wind-up and x1.15 cooldown — wide, long and thick.
worldcombat.skill.mist.veil.1: Thin: radius x0.75, duration x0.75, density x0.85, in exchange for -2 ticks wind-up and x0.8 cooldown — quick to raise and refresh.
worldcombat.skill.mist.timing: Cast on yourself: after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP; the recovery is %3$s and the cooldown %5$s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.mist.preference.veil.h: Dense: radius x1.25, duration x1.2, density x1.3, +3 ticks wind-up, x1.15 cooldown — good to hold a position and cover several allies. Thin: radius x0.75, duration x0.75, density x0.85, -2 ticks wind-up, x0.8 cooldown — good to keep the whole team covered on the move.
worldcombat.skill.mist.preference.ai.max: The partner only considers raising the mist while a threat is this close; smaller keeps it for melee pressure, larger prepares from farther away.
worldcombat.skill.mist.preference.ai.ope: Under pressure: only while a foe is attacking the partner or its owner, or the partner was just hurt. Anytime: raise the mist on any threat.
worldcombat.skill.mist.preference.ai.lea: When on, the partner will also leave its post to raise the mist.
